title: Ligaments
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Assess the cruciates on the sagittal images with the knee in slight external rotation, which brings the anterior cruciate into plane.
Confirm on the coronal and axial planes, because the sagittal plane alone can make a normal ligament disappear.
Assess the collaterals on the coronal images along their length.
Assess the posterolateral structures deliberately, since they are oblique and small.
A ligament reported abnormal in a stable knee should be checked against the protocol and the position before it is believed.
